field.hasAcceptedTerms: I accept the terms of use

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.saveFailed: Could not save the profile. Check the fields and try again
edit.assistantHint: What the assistant remembers about you and the space — review and remove
edit.workspaceHint: Primary space, leaving, renaming and creating a new one

avatar.title: Choose an avatar
avatar.subtitle: Pick a picture for your profile

main.title: Main
main.userNameHint: 3–20 characters: Latin letters, digits, “_” and “.”. Space members find you by your username
main.phoneHint: A plus and 11 digits — you can sign in with it too
main.passwordOnly: Link Telegram or VK, or confirm your email — without them only support can restore a forgotten password
main.loadFailed: Could not load your account. Refresh the page

email.sent: We sent a link — check your inbox

external.lastLoginHint: Set a password or link another login first

password.title: Password
password.saved: Password saved. Other sessions have been signed out

userNameBanner.text: Your username is {login}. Space members find you by it — choose a clear one

fresh.title: Confirm it's you
fresh.passwordHint: Linking, unlinking, changing the email and merging accounts require your password, so nobody at your computer can take the account. The confirmation lasts 10 minutes
fresh.reloginHint: This account has no password — sign in again with Telegram or VK and repeat the action within 10 minutes

merge.startHint: Prove the other account is yours too: sign in to it with its username and password, Telegram or VK.
merge.startPassword: Username and password of the other account
merge.title: Merging accounts
merge.hint: Choose the account to keep — the other one is deleted. Keep the one with more data.
merge.onlyStays: This account has an admin role — it can only be kept
merge.youngAccount: This account was created less than a day ago — only the current one can be kept
merge.fateMoves: membership moves to the kept account
merge.soloGoes: Its “{name}” (only this account) is deleted with all its contents.
merge.membershipMoves: Its membership in “{name}” moves to {kept} — the permissions are combined.
merge.notMoved: Invitations issued by {removed} are not moved — they stay without an author.
merge.loginDropped: Sign-in with {login} of {removed} is dropped: {kept} already has its own.
merge.empty: The merge preview has expired or was not opened — start from your profile.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: The account is deleted right away and for good: the username, email, phone, Telegram and VK are released, and nothing will sign in to it.
delete.soloTitle: Deleted together with the account — you are their only member
delete.authorship: Invitations you issued there stay — without an author.
delete.loadFailed: Could not load your account. Refresh the page
